note: One change against mpsenet_esc: half of the remixed items take their speech from Zeroth-Korean (OpenSLR 40, CC BY 4.0; 6,096 three-second clips of 105 speakers, the 10 speakers with background noise left out) instead of the course clean file, scaled to that file's level. So 50 % of the items are as recorded, 25 % course speech remixed, 25 % Zeroth speech remixed; the noise of a remixed item is course or ESC-50 (folds 1-4) half and half as before. From scratch, no pretrained weights.
